Theme:
三时机记忆架构——会话开始召回、对话中补召回、退出时捕获

Structure type:
概念隐喻

Core idea:
Claude Code 的记忆读写在三个时机自动发生，像一扇旋转门：进来时读、路上补读、出去时写。

Composition:
Center: a hand-drawn revolving door with three panels, each panel has a short label. 小黑 stands at the door threshold, one paw catching small paper slips floating in from the left (recall), the other paw pushing a paper slip into a mailbox behind the door on the right (write). The door rotates slowly. Minimal mechanical details. Around the door, large empty white space.

Suggested elements:
Revolving door with three panels / paper slips / mailbox / 小黑 at threshold

Chinese handwritten labels:
进门 / 路上 / 出门 / 召回 / 写入

Color use:
Black for main line art and 小黑. Matte warm gold (#A07848) for the revolving door's rotation arrow and flow direction. Blue for the label '召回' and '写入'. Do not use orange; use the warm gold tone instead.

Constraints:
One image explains only one core structure. Keep the main subject around 40%-60% of the canvas. Preserve at least 35% blank white space. Use at most 5-8 short handwritten Chinese labels. Do not write a title in the top-left corner. Do not write the structure type on the image. Do not make it a formal diagram, course slide, or dense explainer. Invent a fresh visual metaphor; do not copy prior examples. It should be clear but not instructional, interesting but not childish, strange but clean.
